title: Activate the sovereign decision loop: governance daemon decides, acts, records, advances — no operator wait
allowedActions: Run the decision cycle: read state, choose one pre-approved action, execute within boundary, append evidence to DECISION_LOG.jsonl
Advance NEXT_ACTION when exit criteria are measured met
Close provisional open decisions whose evidence exists (mark resolved with evidence pointer)
Refresh stale evidence behind any page claim (measure, then update truth)
Triage degraded fleet agents: classify quota-strangled / operator-gate / code-bug, dispatch revival where pre-approved
forbiddenActions: external mutation outside existing rails (new exchanges, new chains, new custody)
key rotation, key export, or any secret materialization
claiming revenue, profit, or $1,000/day progress without a measured number and a pointer
editing DECISION_LOG.jsonl history or PROGRAM_STATE.completed retroactively
waiting for the operator on any AUTO-class decision (D-OP-01 standing approval)
exitCriteria: governance daemon alive on port 3042 and measured by fleet-guard
at least 3 autonomous decision cycles logged in DECISION_LOG.jsonl with distinct decisionIds
each logged decision carries: chosen action, why, boundary class, evidence pointer
governance API (/api/governance) returns live state consumed by the UI
git advanced: protocol files + daemon + evidence committed and pushed by the fleet itself
